title: No Name on the Work Roll
journal: I woke in the hold of a barge among a gang of strangers. The door is locked. An Argonian woman named Okeeh is watching me. I should speak to her and find out where I am.
objectives: Speak to Okeeh in the barge's hold. (marker: Okeeh)

plan.going: I am in a locked ship's hold with strangers and know nothing else.
plan.next: Speak to Okeeh, the woman watching me.
plan.ways: There is one way on, to talk to her. I carry two lockpicks, but the door has no lock I can pick.

answers: I woke in a barge hold among strangers; the door is locked. An Argonian woman, Okeeh, is watching me. I do not know why I am here or who I work for.
Speak to Okeeh at Barge Hold (marker).
Talk to Okeeh; other options unknown. There is a locked door, I have a lockpick, and other people (Dralin Uveran) and creatures are nearby.
I do not understand where Ashgate Landing is, who Okeeh or Dralin Uveran are, or what the work roll means. I could find out by talking to people.

title: No Name on the Work Roll
journal: Okeeh told me where I am: the hold of an Owing barge moored at Ashgate Landing, a reed-cutters' camp in Black Marsh, where the gang cut reed for the months they owe. I gave her my name, and now she wants to know what my trade was. She says the door stays barred until the gang-master takes our names.

plan.going: I am in the hold of an Owing barge at Ashgate Landing, a reed-cutters' camp in Black Marsh. The Owing is the marsh's sentence: months of owed work in place of a cell. The door stays locked until the gang-master takes the new gang's names.
plan.next: Tell Okeeh what my trade was.
plan.ways: Seven answers: warrior, hunter, thief, battlemage, healer, nightblade (each names the five skills it raises by five), or naming my own five skills one by one.

answers: I am on a work barge at Ashgate Landing, Black Marsh, with a gang serving the Owing: months of owed work cutting reed instead of a cell. Gang-master Dralin Uveran will take names onto his roll; until then the door is locked.
Tell Okeeh my trade, here in the Barge Hold, after giving my name.
The game offers seven trade topics (fighter, hunter, thief, poultice-maker among them); I will see them.
I do not fully understand what the Owing really is, what a Hist is, or Jal-Veesa; Okeeh has topics on these I can ask about.

title: No Name on the Work Roll
journal: I told Okeeh I was a hunter. Then we heard the bar lift from the hold's door, and Okeeh told me I can go out onto the landing now, where the gang-master waits.
objectives: Go out onto the landing. (marker: Door to Barge Hold)

plan.going: My trade is told. The bar was lifted from the hold's door outside, and Okeeh told me I can go out onto the landing, where the gang-master waits.
plan.next: Go out through the door onto the landing.

answers: I told Okeeh I was a hunter; the door has been unbarred. The gang-master Dralin Uveran waits outside to take my name onto his roll.
Go out through the Barge Hold door onto the landing at Ashgate Landing and speak to Dralin.
Go out now, or first ask Okeeh more (Owing, Hist, Jal-Veesa).
I still do not know what a Hist or Jal-Veesa is; Okeeh has topics for them.

title: No Name on the Work Roll
journal: Dralin Uveran, the Dunmer gang-master of Ashgate Landing, met me on the landing. He struck my name from his roll this morning, on an order brought by Vosh-Leera, the root-herald of Jal-Veesa, so I owe no months. He does not know why she wants me, and he is sour about it. He says she will have work for me if I bring her some Sithis' beard, a grey moss that hangs on the woven weir at Reed-Sill Weir, east up the road. Before I go, he offered me one thing from what dead cutters left behind: a Naga warhammer, a Naga sword, a bamboo bow with arrows and a flint knife, or a spell tome of Sparks. I should take my pick, or tell him I will manage without.
objectives: Take your pick of Dralin's gear, or tell him you will manage. (marker: Dralin Uveran)

plan.going: I am free of the Owing: Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, had my name struck from the roll. I do not know why. She will have work for me if I bring her Sithis' beard. Dralin offers me one piece of dead cutters' gear for the road.
plan.next: Choose one of Dralin's four pieces of gear, or tell him I will manage; then the moss at Reed-Sill Weir.
plan.ways: A choice of one: the warhammer (Two-Handed), the sword (One-Handed), the bow with arrows and a knife (Archery), or the tome of Sparks (Destruction); or none. Whichever I take, the others are gone.

answers: My name was struck from the Owing roll on orders of Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, so I owe no months. She wants Sithis beard moss from Reed-Sill Weir and will have work for me. Dralin does not know why.
Choose a piece of gear from Dralin (talk to him), then go east to Reed-Sill Weir for Sithis beard, mind crocodiles, then to Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa.
Choose warhammer, sword, bamboo bow with arrows and knife, or Sparks tome, or decline. As a hunter I lean to the bow.
I do not know why Vosh-Leera wants me, who has friends in high places for me, or what Jal-Veesa and its tree are; I can ask around.
